name: Pricing
description: Three pricing cards built on quantities of a single product, with a highlighted option, feature lists, and CTAs.

name: Newsletter popup
description: A modal signup built on the native <dialog> element: opens over a dimmed backdrop, closes on the ✕ or a backdrop click.

name: Gallery
description: A responsive thumbnail grid with hover captions. Click any card to open it in a lightbox.

name: Tabs
description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place. Click a tab to switch.

name: What's in the box
description: A collapsible contents tree built from nested <details>: sections expand and collapse, no JavaScript.

name: Toggle content
description: A switch that reveals or hides a block of content. CSS-only, using :has().

name: FAQ, expanded by default
description: The accordion pattern with every item open on load (set the open attribute). Collapse any you don't need.

name: Contact form
description: A labelled form with focus states and a demo submit (no backend attached).

name: Breadcrumbs
description: A path trail showing the visitor's location, with the current page un-linked.
